title: Demon Selfie
description: A young woman in black lingerie sits cross-legged on a red bed, taking a selfie with a glowing pink smartphone. She wears a black-and-white bandana while a large blue demon with horns and a red tattered scarf emerges from a stone archway on the right, reaching toward her, as the same demon is reflected in an ornate mirror on the left.
prompt: A young woman with long brown hair wearing a black and white patterned bandana and black lingerie sits cross-legged on a red bed inside a gothic stone chamber with mossy walls. She holds a glowing pink smartphone taking a selfie. A large muscular blue demon with horns, glowing eyes and a red tattered scarf emerges from a green-lit stone archway reaching toward her. The same demon appears in an ornate oval mirror beside her. Pink and purple ambient lighting, footprints on the floor, dramatic fantasy atmosphere.
